# 编译源码、读取诊断与序列化输出

[API 任务入口](../../index.md) · [公开模块](../index.md)

`compileSource` 适合编辑器、测试和单段源码；`compileProject` 接收文件列表与编译选项。两者做类型检查和静态降低，不执行用户源码。失败时读取 `diagnostics`，成功后遍历 `outputs`。

输出是带 `format` 判别字段的联合：PDX 使用 `document`，Lua 使用 `text`。统一调用 `emitCompileOutput` 获取原生文本，不要假设所有输出都是 PDX。编译接口不会替代项目层的资源复制、依赖打包和世界验证。

## 使用示例

```ts
import { compileSource, emitCompileOutput } from "krieg-lang/compiler";

const result = compileSource(`
  import { CountryEvent } from "krieg-lang/hoi4";
  CountryEvent({ id: "example.1", hidden: true, isTriggeredOnly: true });
`);
if (!result.success) console.error(result.diagnostics);
else for (const output of result.outputs) {
  console.log(output.path, emitCompileOutput(output));
}
```

## renderFocusTreeMermaid() { #renderfocustreemermaid }

> **renderFocusTreeMermaid**(`document`: [`PdxDocument`](../pdx/construct.md#pdxdocument), `treeId?`: `string`): `string`

Defined in: [src/compiler/focus-preview.ts:47](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/compiler/focus-preview.ts#L47)

Render a selected native focus tree as a static Mermaid prerequisite graph.

### Parameters { #renderfocustreemermaid-section-parameters }

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `document` | [`PdxDocument`](../pdx/construct.md#pdxdocument) |
| `treeId?` | `string` |

### Returns { #renderfocustreemermaid-section-returns }

`string`

### Remarks { #renderfocustreemermaid-section-remarks }

Accepts actual compiled/parsed PDX; it never evaluates author source.
Pass a document combining national-focus files to resolve shared/joint branches.
Multiple prerequisite groups feed an AND gate; each multi-focus group uses OR.
Missing definitions remain explicit external nodes. Shared descendants present
in the supplied document are included, without evaluating allow_branch.
Conditions, bypasses, scripted completion, localisation and game positions are
not simulated. A one-way native exclusion stays directed; symmetric exclusions
become one undirected dotted edge. Ambiguous or missing tree IDs are errors.


## TracePoint { #tracepoint }
